ops_radio_check_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops, radio check. Brief is unchanged. Check in with Magic at ARROW.
ops_radio_check_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_radio_check_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops, loud and clear. No change to the threat picture. Magic at ARROW.
ops_radio_check_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_radio_check_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Weather is as briefed, threat is as briefed. Window opens on your push from ARROW.
ops_radio_check_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_radio_check_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops, radio check. Cyclops Two is airborne and waiting on you. Magic at ARROW.
ops_radio_check_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ground_taxi_v1.text: Python One-One, Incirlik Ground, taxi runway zero-five, hold short.
ground_taxi_v1.speaker: tower_incirlik

ground_taxi_v2.text: Python One-One, Ground, runway zero-five, taxi via parallel, hold short.
ground_taxi_v2.speaker: tower_incirlik

ground_taxi_v3.text: Python One-One, Incirlik Ground, wind calm, taxi zero-five, contact Tower holding short.
ground_taxi_v3.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_departure_v1.text: Python One-One, Incirlik Tower, airborne. Contact departure.
tower_departure_v1.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_departure_v2.text: Python One-One, Tower, no traffic. Frequency change approved.
tower_departure_v2.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_departure_v3.text: Python One-One, Incirlik Tower. Climb as filed, contact departure. Good day.
tower_departure_v3.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_departure_v4.text: Python One-One, Tower, airborne at the hour. Switch departure.
tower_departure_v4.speaker: tower_incirlik

magic_checkin_v1.text: Python, Magic, radar contact at ARROW. Picture clean. Push Rook Ops.
magic_checkin_v1.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_checkin_v2.text: Python, Magic, contact. No air south of the border. Rook Ops has your push.
magic_checkin_v2.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_checkin_v3.text: Python, Magic, radar contact, ARROW. Picture clean. Cyclops Two is with me.
magic_checkin_v3.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_checkin_v4.text: Python, Magic, identified. Clean, no factor traffic. Contact Rook Ops for push.
magic_checkin_v4.speaker: awacs_magic

ops_window_open_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Window is open, push. Cyclops Two is inbound to Al Bab.
ops_window_open_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_open_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops, push. Ten minutes from now. Cyclops is on its way in.
ops_window_open_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_open_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Push, push. Cyclops Two is coming in behind you. Keep them quiet.
ops_window_open_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_open_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Window open. Cyclops Two inbound, ten minutes on station.
ops_window_open_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

pike_fence_in_v2.text: Two's fenced in. Pod's up. Nothing on the scope.
pike_fence_in_v2.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_fence_in_v3.text: Python, Two, fenced in, master arm hot, naked.
pike_fence_in_v3.speaker: wingman_pike

ops_sa6_elint_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. ELINT has a Straight Flush coming up, south-east of Al Bab.
ops_sa6_elint_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa6_elint_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. SA-6 search radar active. South-east of the town. Expect it to go quiet fast.
ops_sa6_elint_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa6_elint_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. The SA-6 is waking up. One of the briefed sites. HTS should see it.
ops_sa6_elint_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa6_elint_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Straight Flush, south-east of Al Bab, intermittent. He's looking.
ops_sa6_elint_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

pike_magnum_v4.text: Two, Magnum, Magnum. Six is up.
pike_magnum_v4.speaker: wingman_pike

magic_cyclops_defending_v1.text: Python, Magic. Cyclops Two defending. SAM launch south-east of Al Bab.
magic_cyclops_defending_v1.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_cyclops_defending_v2.text: Python, Magic. Cyclops reports launch. Defending.
magic_cyclops_defending_v2.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_cyclops_defending_v3.text: Python, Magic. Cyclops Two is engaged by the SA-6. Defending north.
magic_cyclops_defending_v3.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_cyclops_defending_v4.text: Python, Magic. SAM launch on Cyclops Two. Defending.
magic_cyclops_defending_v4.speaker: awacs_magic

ops_cyclops_lost_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Cyclops Two has lost link. Assess it shot down.
ops_cyclops_lost_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_cyclops_lost_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Cyclops is gone. Stay on the radar.
ops_cyclops_lost_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_cyclops_lost_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. No link from Cyclops Two. Copy it as lost. Continue.
ops_cyclops_lost_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

magic_cyclops_ok_v1.text: Python, Magic. Cyclops Two defended, back in the orbit.
magic_cyclops_ok_v1.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_cyclops_ok_v2.text: Python, Magic. Cyclops is clear. Resuming.
magic_cyclops_ok_v2.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_cyclops_ok_v3.text: Python, Magic. Cyclops Two reports the missile went stupid. Back on station.
magic_cyclops_ok_v3.speaker: awacs_magic

ops_radar_down_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. ELINT has the Straight Flush off the air. Copy your shot.
ops_radar_down_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_radar_down_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. The Straight Flush stopped mid-scan. I'll take that.
ops_radar_down_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_radar_down_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. SA-6 radar is down. Launchers are still out there.
ops_radar_down_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_radar_down_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Copy. Six radar off the air. Get eyes on the site if you can.
ops_radar_down_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

pike_battery_dead_v1.text: Python, Two. No movement at the SA-6 site. Vehicles burning.
pike_battery_dead_v1.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_battery_dead_v2.text: Two. Pod shows the whole site burning.
pike_battery_dead_v2.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_battery_dead_v3.text: Python, Two, good effect. Six site's done.
pike_battery_dead_v3.speaker: wingman_pike

ops_sa8_warning_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Ground reporting, short-range SAM moving near Al Bab. No location.
ops_sa8_warning_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa8_warning_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Possible SA-8 close to the town. Watch for launches.
ops_sa8_warning_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa8_warning_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. A SAM vehicle just moved near Al Bab. Not on the list.
ops_sa8_warning_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa8_warning_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Possible pop-up SA-8 around Al Bab. Keep your speed up.
ops_sa8_warning_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

pike_sa8_spike_v1.text: Python, Two, pop-up SAM near the town. Defending.
pike_sa8_spike_v1.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_sa8_spike_v3.text: Python, Two, pop-up SAM, low. Chaff, flares. Defending.
pike_sa8_spike_v3.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_sa8_spike_v4.text: Two, missile in the air off the town. Defending, defending.
pike_sa8_spike_v4.speaker: wingman_pike

ops_sa8_dead_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Copy pop-up SAM destroyed. Logging it.
ops_sa8_dead_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa8_dead_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Copy. That SAM won't move again.
ops_sa8_dead_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_sa8_dead_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. One short-range SAM off the list. Copy.
ops_sa8_dead_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_closed_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Window closed. Cleared to hunt emitters for five minutes, then RTB.
ops_window_closed_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_closed_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Time. Window's closed. Five minutes for anything that emitted.
ops_window_closed_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_closed_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Window closed. You're cleared DEAD on what you've found. Five minutes.
ops_window_closed_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_closed_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. End of window. Hunt for five, then come home.
ops_window_closed_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_held_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Cyclops Two stayed on station the whole window. Copy. Nice work.
ops_window_held_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_held_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Cyclops has its pictures of Al Bab. Copy.
ops_window_held_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_held_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Cyclops Two reports a full orbit. Intel is happy. So am I.
ops_window_held_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_held_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Window held. Cyclops is staying on to look north-east.
ops_window_held_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_failed_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. No ISR over Al Bab today. Hunt what you can.
ops_window_failed_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_failed_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Window's a loss. Find the radar that did it.
ops_window_failed_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_window_failed_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. We'll talk about Cyclops on the ground. Five minutes, then RTB.
ops_window_failed_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_rtb_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Vul time. RTB, BDA on deck.
ops_rtb_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_rtb_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. That's time. Come home. Shell is on the track if you need it.
ops_rtb_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_rtb_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Off station. RTB Incirlik. Bring both jets.
ops_rtb_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_rtb_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Vul end. RTB, say BDA on deck, not on this net.
ops_rtb_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

tower_land_v1.text: Python One-One, Incirlik Tower, runway zero-five, cleared to land.
tower_land_v1.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_land_v2.text: Python One-One, Tower, wind calm, runway zero-five, cleared to land.
tower_land_v2.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_land_v3.text: Python One-One, Incirlik Tower, report initial, runway zero-five.
tower_land_v3.speaker: tower_incirlik

tower_land_v4.text: Python One-One, Tower, no traffic. Cleared to land zero-five.
tower_land_v4.speaker: tower_incirlik

ops_on_deck_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Copy on deck. Debrief in the vault.
ops_on_deck_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_on_deck_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Copy wheels down. Tapes to intel before you eat.
ops_on_deck_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_on_deck_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. On deck, copy. Debrief in thirty.
ops_on_deck_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_on_deck_v4.text: Python, Rook Ops. Copy. Bring the HTS tapes to the vault.
ops_on_deck_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

pike_aaa_v1.text: Python, Two, triple-A, north-west edge of town.
pike_aaa_v1.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_aaa_v2.text: Two, triple-A, low, off the town. Not a factor.
pike_aaa_v2.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_aaa_v3.text: Python, Two, guns up, Al Bab, well below us.
pike_aaa_v3.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_aaa_v4.text: Two, tracers, north-west side. Staying high.
pike_aaa_v4.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_manpads_v1.text: Python, Two, missile launch, low, off the town. Flares.
pike_manpads_v1.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_manpads_v2.text: Two, smoke trail, coming up off the farms. Flares, flares.
pike_manpads_v2.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_manpads_v3.text: Python, Two, launch off the outskirts. Flares, flares.
pike_manpads_v3.speaker: wingman_pike

pike_manpads_v4.text: Two, MANPADS launch, short of us. Flares.
pike_manpads_v4.speaker: wingman_pike

ops_say_status_v2.text: Python, Rook Ops. Say your status. Gaziantep is your nearest divert.
ops_say_status_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_say_status_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Report damage when able. Head north if in doubt.
ops_say_status_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_check_fire_v1.text: Python, Rook Ops. Check fire, check fire. That was a civilian vehicle on the Al Bab road.
ops_check_fire_v1.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_check_fire_v2.text: Check fire, check fire. Python, Rook Ops, civilian vehicle hit. Confirm PID on your next target.
ops_check_fire_v2.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_check_fire_v3.text: Python, Rook Ops. Check fire. Civilian traffic hit near Al Bab. Stop and reassess.
ops_check_fire_v3.speaker: ops_lindqvist

ops_check_fire_v4.text: Check fire. Python, Rook Ops. That was not a technical. We'll discuss it on deck.
ops_check_fire_v4.speaker: ops_lindqvist

magic_picture_v2.text: Python, Magic. Clean. Shell is on the track, north.
magic_picture_v2.speaker: awacs_magic

magic_picture_v3.text: Python, Magic. No change. Cyclops Two holding over Al Bab.
magic_picture_v3.speaker: awacs_magic
